description: ADR 0068 D2: raw scans and loops per file on the parse+render path. Regenerate counts with `node scripts/check-scan-census.cjs --write`; a changed count needs its reason updated in the same commit. A `*` in a scope entry's file name stands for every matching file of that directory, so a new file on the path fails until it is listed here.

markdown/inlineScanMemo.ts.reason: 3 ROUTE sites are counted at the native call (countedIndexOf / countedMatchIndex, or countSteps beside a native call that stays); a memo hit adds 0. The 3 loops count every character they read: pairBrackets and pairParens walk the text once per scan; walkToClosingParen walks from one link open paren to its close, and the scan pairs the whole text once those walks pass its length, so a scan reads it at most three times (osionos#321).

markdown/parserInline.ts.reason: 2 ROUTE sites are counted at the native call (countedIndexOf / countedMatchIndex, or countSteps beside a native call that stays) (the main-loop count covers the run walk); 2 BOUNDED sites scan a constant-bounded span (matcher list for one char, module init); 1 BOUNDED-COPY sites copy a span only on the success path, and the nested scan counts it again.

markdown/parserInlineMatchers.ts.reason: 24 ROUTE sites are counted: 22 at the native call (countedIndexOf / countedMatchIndex, or countSteps beside a native call that stays), and the 2 raw marker indexOf in matchStackedEmphasis add their indexOfSpan to a local that one countSteps adds after the loop (ADR 0068 D4: a counted call per scan cost inline mixed 10K +3.6 %, batched +2.4 %; its escape and backtick lookups go through the scan memo, osionos#321); 13 BOUNDED sites scan a constant-bounded span (module init, VARIABLE_MAX_EXPR 256, fixed tags); 16 BOUNDED-COPY sites copy a span only on the success path, and the nested scan counts it again. Residuals: the bare-URL shape test (line ~59) runs only on the editor gate, not parse+render (UNSURE, uncounted); none for the autolink, whose URL regex became startsWith (osionos#321) and whose email check is the one-pass isEmailAutolink (ADR 0068 R6, C6a). The link destination walk (a loop) moved to inlineScanMemo.ts findClosingParen, one walk per scan (osionos#321). The title split's countSteps stays beside its scan, now blockLineMatchers.ts splitQuotedTitle instead of a backtracking exec (osionos#240).
